summary: v2.29 web release fully verified end-to-end (backend + web UI). Backend pytest 6/6 pass. (1) Closer Handoff Alert: POST /api/crm/leads/{id}/closer sets closer, returns {ok:true, closer_name:<name>}, non-blocking push warning is logged and does NOT fail the request; passing closer_id:null clears the field and returns closer_name:null (no alert). (2) Digest Preview: GET /api/crm/notifications/digest/preview returns {window_hours,total_leads,reps:[{rep_id,rep_name,email,count,leads}]}, respects ?window_hours=, allowed for lead_manager (Fatema/Sam), forbidden for account_manager (403). Modal on /crm/teams opens correctly (data-testid digest-preview), listed 10 leads across 3 reps with lead_number/name/tier per rep. (3) Territory Rebalance: POST /api/crm/leads/route-by-territory routes unassigned leads to their matching territory's team round-robin (NY→East team, routing_reason starts with 'Territory rebalance'), skips leads with no matching territory (no-state ZZTEST lead stayed unassigned), returns {ok,routed,skipped,by_team}; account_manager gets 403. Teams header button (route-by-territory) fires the endpoint and toasts the routed/skipped summary ('Routed X to their territory team'); existing 'Route Unassigned' button still present and functional. Regression: creating a lead via POST /api/crm/leads still auto-routes (territory match happens). Only outstanding note is the pre-existing cosmetic <span>-inside-<option> hydration warning on the Dashboard, carried from v2.27/v2.28 — non-blocking, not v2.29-caused.

issues: Carry-over: React hydration console warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' (from tier <select>). Non-functional, dropdown renders correctly.

action_items: No blocking issues. v2.29 is ready to ship.
(Optional / carry-over) Fix the <span>-inside-<option> hydration warning in Dashboard tier <select> — same one flagged in iteration_25.

(Env note, not a v2.29 bug) fatema@healthandmore.net still has must_change_pin=true in the preview DB, so logging in as her forces /change-pin. Backend permission check for lead_manager was covered via pytest using the lead_manager role guard directly.

critical_code_review_comments: routes_teams.py:218-239 route_by_territory: uses to_list(5000) on unassigned+non-archived leads. For very large backlogs this silently caps. Consider a cursor or paginated worker.

routes_teams.py:230-231 _rr_team_pick returning None (empty team) increments 'skipped' but does not distinguish 'no territory' vs 'team has no members' in the response. Adding a small 'skipped_reasons' breakdown would help admins triage.
routes_digest.py:31-54 build_digest_preview: fetches up to 10000 leads then does a per-rep users.find_one in a loop → N+1 read pattern. Batch the user lookup with a single $in query.

routes_digest.py:87-96 both trigger_digest (POST /digest/run) and digest_preview (GET /digest/preview) are guarded by MANAGER (lead_manager+). Spec allows lead_manager for preview but the review request says account_manager should be 403; that's already the case, so ok. However, /digest/run is triggerable by any lead_manager — if this should be admin-only, tighten to require_admin.

routes_push.py:113-135 notify_closer_assigned swallows all push+email errors as warnings (correct for non-blocking) — good, matches spec that 'EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY missing or invalid' must not fail the request. Verified.
Teams.js:88-98 routeByTerritory uses window.confirm() which is jarring on modern UIs. A Sonner confirm/dialog would fit the rest of the UX; non-blocking.
Teams.js digest-preview modal: renders all reps at once; if there are many reps + long lists this can be tall. Preview already caps each rep's lead list at 25 with a '…and N more' hint — good.
